items.description: S3 Arctic UAS with EO/IR gimbal

notes: S3 Arctic demo for Canadian Defense Forces via NexTech Solutions integrator. 120km range / 1h 35min TOF with EO/IR gimbal required. Demo scheduled for Ottawa June 25, 2026. REX110 gimbal integration in final push with Atmolab troubleshooting camera auto-discovery; DB9 rewiring and mount integration tasks underway. Battery shipped to Canada. Insurance requirements ($5M GL/Aviation) coordinated. BST team traveling mid-June for demo; follow-on Arctic demo planned post-Ottawa. Flights booked for Dan and team to Ottawa; demo logistics confirmed.
